lines: Aye dil mujhe aisi jagah le chal jahan koi na ho
couplets.en: Take me, my heart, somewhere there is no one.

lines: Apna paraya mehrban na-mehrban koi na ho
couplets.en: Let there be no one, dear or strange, tender or unkind.

lines: Ja kar kahin kho jaaun main

lines: Neend aaye aur so jaaun main
